correctness.rationale: Independent uniform output packet marks give a deterministic equivalence on N0>floor(t/a). Conditional prefix nonmatching is a walk with increments +1 and -(a-1); an exact generalized cycle-lemma count yields a finite sum that collapses to the binomial atom at p=1/a. Binomial Chernoff gives the uniform e^{-n/(8a)} coupling error; Stirling and a tail-sum identity yield the sharp constants. A standalone standard-library checker reproduced 3919 exact rational assertions, including actual small shuffle enumerations; finite assertions do not replace proof.
